events.title: Hurricane Trudy menaces Mexico’s Pacific coast and Greece hit by deadly floods
events.description: Trudy weakens to tropical storm after warnings of strong winds and heavy rain, while one person killed in Greece In contrast to the quiet Atlantic hurricane season, there has been ongoing activity in the Pacific, with Trudy being the 22nd and latest named system. The category 2 hurricane remained roughly 100 miles (160km) south-west of the coast of Mexico, meaning the worst of the conditions stayed offshore. However, the US National Hurricane Center put coastal parts of the states of Jalisco, Michoacán and Colima under hurricane warnings, with sustained winds of up to 60-90mph forecast on Sunday. Rainfall totals of 100-150mm were likely for these areas, prompting warnings of flooding and landslides. Warnings also covered the risk of a dangerous storm surge accompanied by damaging waves in areas of onshore winds across the coast of south-western Mexico. By Monday morning, Trudy had weakened and been downgraded to a tropical storm, with coastal warnings being lifted. Continue reading...
events.ticker_label: 🌪️ Hurricane Trudy menaces Mexico’s Pacific coast and Greece hit by deadly floods

events.title: Sudan’s war escalates as UN warns of wider regional crisis

Also, health authorities prepare to coordinate a response as Ebola cases emerge in Nigeria and rise in Kenya. Finally, ten years after Cameroon’s deadliest railway disaster, families of the 79 victims are still fighting for justice, saying their pain has yet to be acknowledged.

events.title: 'Neither the Sudanese military, nor the RSF take any acknowledgement of human life in this war'

Authorities in Abyei district said the strike on the Amiet market involved the use of multiple munitions and was carried out by the Sudanese army. FRANCE 24's Mark Owen speaks with Jan Pospisil, Sudan Affairs Analyst at the Peace and Conflict Resolution Evidence Platform. He says that for a long time the Sudanese army has tried "to portray a picture internationally that they are humane, whereas RSF is committing atrocities. Here we see very clearly that there is not much difference between these two".

events.title: Football: German coach Hürzeler flying high in Premier League
events.description: Fabian Hürzeler is younger than his star player, a fellow Premier League German. But, contrary to his reputation in his homeland, Hürzeler has become a popular figure both on and off the pitch in England.

events.title: India news: India-US trade deal 'pretty close,' says Trump
events.description: US President Donald Trump hinted that the US-India trade deal could look different from the previous ones.

events.title: Real Madrid thrash RB Leipzig as Mbappe scores in Champions League win
events.description: Real Madrid thrashed RB Leipzig 4-1 on Wednesday to secure their third consecutive Champions League victory. Bernardo Silva, Arda Guler, Kylian Mbappe and Yan Diomande scored for Jose Mourinho’s side, while Tidiam Gomis replied for Leipzig. Mbappe has scored in all three European matches this season, taking his tally to 12 goals.
events.ticker_label: 💥 Real Madrid thrash RB Leipzig as Mbappe scores in Champions League win

events.title: Canadian publisher drops author Orelien after confirming he used AI in debut novel
events.description: The Canadian publisher representing Thélyson Orélien on Wednesday said it had dropped the prize-nominated writer over new information indicating that he did use artificial intelligence to write his acclaimed debut.

events.title: Man arrested in Pakistan over $126m counterfeit postage scheme
events.description: A man has been arrested in Pakistan and accused of running a counterfeit postage operation costing the US Postal Service $126m (£94m).

events.title: Trump's approval rating hits new record low as US midterms loom
events.description: Donald Trump's approval rating has fallen to a record low - indicating that next month's midterm elections could be punishing for the Republicans.

events.title: Brazil's Supreme Court suspends permit for major Amazon gold mine
events.description: Brazil’s Supreme Court has suspended an environmental permit for a major gold mining project in the Amazon rainforest

events.title: Carney says Trump’s tariffs hurt Americans as US Embassy alleges Canadian interference
events.description: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney says that U.S. President Donald Trump’s tariffs have raised costs for American families and upended decades of trade as he unveiled a $6.2 billion plan to protect Canada’s manufacturing heartland

events.title: Hungary’s Magyar vows accountability for Orbán era while holding firm on migration
events.description: Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar is actively pursuing former officials accused of corruption and power abuses

events.title: Meta tells Brazil's electoral court it treats Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro equally ahead of Sunday vote
events.description: Meta says it has complied with an order from Brazil’s electoral court to treat Brazil's presidential candidates equally before Sunday's runoff
events.ticker_label: 💥 Meta tells Brazil's electoral court it treats Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro equally ahead of Sunday vote

events.title: Bangladesh: UNICEF chief calls for an end to child marriage
events.description: At 14, Bushra faced being married off – until community leaders at a UNICEF-supported child protection hub worked with her father to prevent her from being given away against her will.
events.ticker_label: 💥 Bangladesh: UNICEF chief calls for an end to child marriage

events.title: Guterres honours Indonesian troops who paid ‘ultimate sacrifice’
events.description: UN Secretary-General António Guterres paid tribute to Indonesian peacekeepers on Monday, laying a wreath in honour of four who recently lost their lives in Lebanon and offering a robust defence of UN peacekeeping in what he called “testing times for peace”.

events.title: American woman masterminds $6 million marriage fraud scheme, Department of Justice says
events.description: The Department of Justice accuses Jennifer Gonzalez of earning $6 million by arranging sham marriages for green cards over a decade in Massachusetts.

events.title: Max Factor heir's former lawyer details judge's error that wiped out 124-year rape sentence
events.description: A sentencing error cut Andrew Luster's 124-year prison term to 50 years, and a victim's letter asking for leniency played a key role in the outcome.

events.title: Secret sex video rocks University of North Carolina at Charlotte fraternity, 1 arrested: Police
events.description: Alexander Michael Evanoff allegedly sent a secret sex recording to a Sigma Alpha Epsilon group chat at the University of North Carolina at Charlotte.

events.title: Philly officer murdered in line of duty promoted to sergeant as police from around US attend his funeral
events.description: Thousands of officers gathered as Shane Seiber was promoted posthumously to sergeant during an emotional Philadelphia funeral service Tuesday.

events.title: OceanGate CEO Stockton Rush wanted to join ‘Titanic mythology’ when Titan sub imploded, friend claims
events.description: Karl Stanley claims OceanGate CEO Stockton Rush intentionally designed the Titan submersible to implode, calling it a "mousetrap for billionaires."

events.title: Honduran illegal immigrant charged with assaulting ICE officers with hammer during New Jersey traffic stop
events.description: Reinieri De Jesus Licona Amador allegedly grabbed a hammer and swung it at ICE officers during a New Jersey traffic stop before being pepper sprayed.

events.title: Convicted bank robber returns to old tricks with ‘old man’ mask in Florida heists, feds say
events.description: David Sartin Jr. allegedly robbed two Florida banks in a prosthetic "old man" mask weeks after starting supervised release from a 10-year bank robbery sentence.

events.title: Russia releases American teacher imprisoned on Ukraine mercenary charges after Trump pressed Putin
events.description: American Stephen Hubbard has been released from Russian custody after Trump urged Putin to free the retired teacher imprisoned on Ukraine mercenary charges.

events.title: Alberta holds non-binding separation vote as independence fight grips Canada
events.description: About 3 million Albertans are eligible to vote in the non-binding separation referendum, but polls show deep divisions within the UCP over it.
